newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Avonmore Foods Plc members approve merger.
newsitem.headline: Avonmore Foods Plc members approve merger.

text.p: Avonmore Foods Plc on Monday said its plc shareholders voted in favour of a proposed merger with Waterford Foods Plc at an extraordinary meeting.

The proposed merger remains subject to a number of conditions including the passing of certain resolutions by 75 percent of members present and voting at special meetings of Avonmore Creameries Ltd and Waterford Co-operative Society Ltd on July 25.
On July 11, 97.6 percent of Avonmore Creameries members, who own 63.9 percent of Avonmore Foods Plc, voted in favour of the merger. Today the remaining plc members gave the thumbs-up to the move.
Waterford Co-op members already voted overwhelmingly in favour of a merger at a meeting also held on July 11, but it still requires ratification by 75 percent of its members on July 25 to proceed.
If approved, the merger will weld together two of Ireland's premier food companies with a joint turnover of 2.5 billion Irish pounds ($3.8 billion) and pre-tax profits of 71.5 million.
This will create the largest dairy company in Britain and Ireland and the fourth largest milk processor in the world.

Analysts said the merged company's milk production would far outstrip the dairy operations of Britain's Northern Foods Plc and Unigate Plc and its cheese production would account for 20 percent of the British market.
